title: Crispy French Fritters with Indian Beans
description: A delicious and crispy fritter dish made with Indian beans, perfect for a snack or side dish in any French-inspired meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 180°C.
2. In a bowl, mix together the Indian beans, aromatic, crispy, and fritters.
3. Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the mixture into the hot oil.
4. Fry for 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
5. Remove from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
